item.title: THE ZONE: Scores and Highlights – February 6, 2026
item.description: "The Zone" featured highlights from eight high school girls basketball sectional semifinal games from across central Indiana on Friday, including Zionsville vs. Carmel, Noblesville vs. HSE, and more.

item.title: Purdue escapes Oregon’s upset bid, defends home court
item.description: Purdue closed the game on a 6-1 run and beat Oregon, 68-64, with Fletcher Loyer hitting a three-pointer with 51 seconds left to seal the victory.

item.title: The US said a Marine could not adopt an Afghan girl. Records show officials helped him get her
item.description: (AP) — The judge wanted everyone in the courtroom to know that when he’d signed a war orphan over to an American Marine he thought it was an emergency — that the child injured on the battlefield in Afghanistan was on death’s door, with neither a family nor a country to claim her. item.title: 3 die from suspected arson at Monroe County home; suspect in custody
item.description: Two people were found dead and one person died from injuries after a house fire believed to be arson was reported near Bloomington, Indiana. A suspect was taken into custody.

item.title: Deputy describes crash that killed 4 Amish construction workers as ‘horrific’
item.description: A sheriff's deputy talked with News 8's Tim Spears about a crash that killed four people on State Road 67 in Jay County, Indiana. The White House has weighed in on the driver of the semi, a Kyrgyzstan national, who was taken into custody by ICE.

item.title: Cold weekend holds then fast warmup next week | Feb. 7, 2026
item.description: After a cold and mostly cloudy weekend, temperatures will quickly moderate into early week with highs climbing from the 20s Sunday to near 50 Tuesday, followed by a chance of rain and snow mix late Wednesday.

item.title: IMPD launches review of officer’s conduct after video captures traffic stop
item.description: Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department has launched an internal review after a video was circulated on social media of an officer speaking to a juvenile during a traffic stop. The juvenile was arrested for dangerous possession of a firearm.

item.title: Hailey Buzbee’s family invites community to celebration of life
item.description: The family of Hailey Buzbee is inviting the public to join a celebration of life on Thursday to honor the Fishers teenager's memory.
